# MONOLITH CODES

> MONOLITH CODES is a custom software engineering studio. We hand-code websites, web applications, SaaS platforms, mobile apps, ERP/CRM systems and business workflow automation — no templates, no WordPress — and hand over 100% of the IP and source code to the client.

## Services
- Web Experiences & custom websites
- Custom web applications
- Mobile applications (iOS & Android)
- SaaS platforms
- ERP & CRM systems
- AI & automation solutions

## Process
Enquiry & audit → Scope & quote → Approval & initial payment → Design & build → Test & accept → Deploy & handover → Warranty & support.
